explainer.title: What arrives and when
explainer.hint: Three occasions, both channels below. A switch decides whether that occasion reaches you on that channel at all.

REGISTRATION_REQUIRED.name: Registration required
REGISTRATION_REQUIRED.when: Once, soon after an organizer assigns you to an event that has an open registration. It carries the link and the deadline.

REGISTRATION_REMINDER.name: Reminder before the deadline
REGISTRATION_REMINDER.when: At each interval the organizer set before the deadline — for example a day before. There may be several, or none at all.

REGISTRATION_OVERDUE.name: The deadline has passed
REGISTRATION_OVERDUE.when: After the deadline, if the organizer set such a reminder. It stops once the event ends.

explainer.stopTitle: Mark yourself registered and the reminders stop
explainer.stopHint: Reminders go only to people whose registration is still unmarked. Open the event and press "I registered". You set it yourself — the system does not check the external site. Nothing else switches them off for one event.
explainer.timingNote: Sending is checked every few minutes, so a notification can arrive slightly after the moment it was due. A message may also arrive twice: delivery guarantees at least one attempt, not exactly one.
explainer.allOffTitle: Every switch for this occasion is off
explainer.allOffHint: You chose not to receive this notification anywhere. This is separate from the channel list above: even if you later add a channel there, this occasion stays off until you switch it back on here.

card.title: Notification channels
card.hint: Pick every channel that should receive your notifications. Both can be selected at once.
card.setUpInAccount: Telegram and the email address are set up in the Account section.
card.emptyHint: You have no delivery route at all: nothing below can reach you until you pick at least one channel here, whatever its own switches say.

preview.title: Notification preview
preview.subtitle: The text this recipient would receive. Nothing is sent, queued or logged by opening this.
preview.noSideEffects: Preview only: no notification is created and no rule is switched on.
preview.subject: Subject
preview.channelNotReadyHint: This recipient has neither a linked Telegram account nor a verified email, so this notification would end as undeliverable.
preview.nothingHint: This status has no notification to render: the event, the registration or the assignment rules it out.
